questions.question: The amendment of Rule 23 (2) of the Right to Education Act, 2009 highlighted that
options: [A] No detention policy should be enforced
[B] All the states should prepare class-wise, subject-wise learning outcomes
[C] Children can be detained if they fail in the examination
[D] Public examinations should be held in Class III and V.
questions.answer: [B] All the states should prepare class-wise, subject-wise learning outcomes

questions.question: It is not one of the developmental goals of FLN Framework
options: [A] Children participate in games and sports
[B] Children maintain good health and wellbeing
[C] Children become involved learners and connect with their environment
questions.answer: [A] Children participate in games and sports
